set.body:
Outcome

Support PCA, PLS, CCA, or related decompositions only over an explicitly declared observation table, relation table, effect form, or neural form.

Acceptance

- The open object and fitted-data scope are part of plan identity.
- Existing Multivar capabilities are reused without adding MVPA concepts upstream.
- One-fit-many-queries claims are restricted to compatible fit and capability identities.
- Dense or operator materialization policy is explicit.
set.title: P5.6: add declared open-form and global decomposition estimands
